name: API
description: A JSON API over the shop's own resources: every module declares what it exposes, and one controller serves all of them. Token-authenticated, permission-checked with the same rights as the admin panel.

settings.label: Items per page by default
settings.help: What a list returns when the caller does not say. The hard ceiling below is what protects the database from a client asking for everything.

settings.label: Hard ceiling per page
settings.help: A request for more is silently capped, not refused: an integration that asks for 10000 should get 200 and keep working, not fail at three in the morning.

settings.label: Requests per minute, per token
settings.help: Counted per token, not per address: two integrations behind one office NAT must not throttle each other, and one runaway script must not take the others down with it.
